# Code of Conduct

Colleagues, candidates and partners are treated with respect. Discrimination and harassment
are prohibited.

## Company property

Confidential information is accessed only for a legitimate work reason. Gifts above a
nominal value must be declined or handed to HR.

## Honesty

Working time, leave and expenses are recorded truthfully. Falsifying records is a
disciplinary matter.
